24680-the-martyr-of-the-catacombs.title: The Martyr Of The Catacombs
24680-the-martyr-of-the-catacombs.creator: Unknown
24680-the-martyr-of-the-catacombs.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Here were warriors who had fought in foreign wars and were familiar with deeds of valor, yet they felt no indignation at the scenes of cowardly oppression displayed before them; nobles of ancient families were here, but they could find in these brutal shows no stain upon their country's honor.

24827-rita.title: Rita
24827-rita.creator: Unknown
24827-rita.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. _Honoured Señor and Brother:_--There are several months that I wrote to inform you of the deeply deplored death of my lamented husband, Señor Don Richard Montfort. Your letter of condolation and advice was balm poured upon my bleeding wounds, received before yesterday at the hands of my banker, Don Miguel Pietoso. You are the brother of my adored husband, your words are as if spoken from his casket.

59091-the-sixth-sense-its-cultivation-an.title: Its Cultivation And Use
59091-the-sixth-sense-its-cultivation-an.creator: Charles H. Brent
59091-the-sixth-sense-its-cultivation-an.description: A book by Charles H. Brent. and allies him to the highest above him. So distinctive among created objects is it of man that it might, not inaptly, be characterized as the Human Sense. It is used for no one exclusive purpose; on the contrary it is only under its operation that man’s activities, one and all, become human.

arxiv-2202-08909.title: SIGACT News Complexity Theory Column, March 2022
arxiv-2202-08909.creator: Proofs, Circuits, and Communication
arxiv-2202-08909.description: Abstract We survey lower-bound results in complexity theory that have been obtained via newfound interconnections between propositional proof complexity, boolean circuit complexity, and query/communication complexity. We advocate for the theory of total search problems ( TFNP ) as a unifying language for these connections and discuss how this perspective suggests a whole programme for further research.

arxiv-2207-07185.title: Honda-Huang’s work on contact convexity revisited Thanks: YE was partially supported by NSF grant DMS-2104473 and a grant from the Institute for Advanced Study Thanks: DP was partially supported by NSF grant DMS-1926686 during his stay at the Institute for Advanced Study
arxiv-2207-07185.creator: Yakov Eliashberg, Dishant Pancholi
arxiv-2207-07185.description: Abstract . Following the overall strategy of the paper [ 14 ] by Ko Honda and Yang Huang on contact convexity in high dimensions, we present a simplified proof of their main result. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 57R17; Secondary: 37C10 1.

arxiv-2305-09166.title: Finite Difference Solution Ansatz approach in Least-Squares Monte Carlo
arxiv-2305-09166.creator: Jiawei Huo
arxiv-2305-09166.description: Abstract This article presents a simple but effective and efficient approach to improve the accuracy and stability of Least-Squares Monte Carlo. The key idea is to construct the ansatz of conditional expected continuation payoff using the finite difference solution from one dimension, to be used in linear regression.

arxiv-2308-10518.title: Heun-type solutions for the Dirac particle on the curved background of Minkowski space-times
arxiv-2308-10518.creator: © 1999, Springer Verlag Heidelberg All rights reserved, S Rahmani, H Panahi, and A Najafizade Department of Physics, Faculty of Basic Science, University of Guilan, Rasht 41635-1914, Iran.
arxiv-2308-10518.description: Abstract In the present paper, we study the Dirac equation in the background of Minkowski space-time on a light cone. With the help of the coupling of the radial parts, the system of 4 equations is reduced to two different second-order differential equations, which coincide with a particle in present potentials.

arxiv-2309-12449.title: Dynamic Prediction of Delays in Software Projects using Delay Patterns and Bayesian Modeling DOI: 10.1145/3611643.3616328 fse23main-p838-p ISBN: 979-8-4007-0327-0/23/12 Conference: Proceedings of the 31st ACM Joint European Software Engineering Conference and Symposium on the Foundations of Software
arxiv-2309-12449.creator: Elvan Kula, Eric Greuter, Arie van Deursen, Georgios Gousios
arxiv-2309-12449.description: Abstract . Modern agile software projects are subject to constant change, making it essential to re-asses overall delay risk throughout the project life cycle. Existing effort estimation models are static and not able to incorporate changes occurring during project execution. In this paper, we propose a dynamic model for continuously predicting overall delay using delay patterns and Bayesian modeling.

arxiv-2311-08975.title: Constraints on cosmic star formation history via a new modeling of the radio luminosity function of star-forming galaxies
arxiv-2311-08975.creator: Wenjie Wang, Zunli Yuan, Hongwei Yu, Jirong Mao
arxiv-2311-08975.description: Abstract Context. Radio wavelengths offer a unique possibility to trace the total star-formation rate (SFR) in galaxies, both obscured and unobscured. To probe the dust-unbiased star-formation history, an accurate measurement of the radio luminosity function (LF) for star-forming galaxies (SFGs) is crucial. Aims.

arxiv-2312-07748.title: Portability and Scalability Evaluation of Large-Scale Statistical Modeling and Prediction Software through HPC-Ready Containers
arxiv-2312-07748.creator: Sameh Abdulah, Jorge Ejarque, Omar Marzouk, Hatem Ltaief, Ying Sun, Marc G. Genton, Rosa M. Badia, David E. Keyes
arxiv-2312-07748.description: Abstract HPC-based applications often have complex workflows with many software dependencies that hinder their portability on contemporary HPC architectures. In addition, these applications often require extraordinary efforts to deploy and execute at performance potential on new HPC systems, while the users expert in these applications generally have less expertise in HPC and related technologies.

arxiv-2407-09646.title: Hamba: Single-view 3D Hand Reconstruction with Graph-guided Bi-Scanning Mamba
arxiv-2407-09646.creator: Haoye Dong Aviral Chharia ∗ Wenbo Gou ∗ Francisco Vicente Carrasco Fernando De la Torre Carnegie Mellon University
arxiv-2407-09646.description: Abstract 3D Hand reconstruction from a single RGB image is challenging due to the articulated motion, self-occlusion, and interaction with objects. Existing SOTA methods employ attention-based transformers to learn the 3D hand pose and shape, yet they do not fully achieve robust and accurate performance, primarily due to inefficiently modeling spatial relations between joints.

arxiv-2504-03602.title: Robust Human Registration with Body Part Segmentation on Noisy Point Clouds
arxiv-2504-03602.creator: Kai Lascheit Daniel Barath Marc Pollefeys Leonidas Guibas Francis Engelmann, ETH Zurich Microsoft Stanford University Google
arxiv-2504-03602.description: Abstract Registering human meshes to 3D point clouds is essential for applications such as augmented reality and human-robot interaction but often yields imprecise results due to noise and background clutter in real-world data. We introduce a hybrid approach that incorporates body-part segmentation into the mesh fitting process, enhancing both human pose estimation and segmentation accuracy.

For open access purposes, the author has applied a CC BY public copyright license to any author-acce
arxiv-2508-19898.creator: Yannic Maus ⓡ Tijn de Vos
arxiv-2508-19898.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yannic Maus ⓡ Tijn de Vos. We give new, improved bounds for approximating the sparsest cut value or in other words the conductance ϕ \phi of a graph in the 𝖢𝖮𝖭𝖦𝖤𝖲𝖳 \mathsf{CONGEST} model. As our main result, we present an algorithm running in O ⁡ ( log 2 ⁡ n / ϕ ) O(\log^{2}n/\phi) rounds in which every vertex outputs a value ϕ ~ \tilde{\phi} satisfying ϕ ≤ ϕ ~ ≤ 2.01 ​ ϕ \phi\leq\tilde{\phi}\leq\sqrt{2.01\phi} .

arxiv-2602-21351.title: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Autonomous Discovery in Geoscientific Data Archives
arxiv-2602-21351.creator: Dmitrii Pantiukhin, Ivan Kuznetsov, Boris Shapkin, Antonia Anna Jost, Thomas Jung, Nikolay Koldunov
arxiv-2602-21351.description: Abstract The rapid accumulation of Earth science data has created a significant scalability challenge; while repositories like PANGAEA host vast collections of datasets, citation metrics indicate that a substantial portion remains underutilized, limiting data reusability. Here we present PANGAEA-GPT, a hierarchical multi-agent framework designed for autonomous data discovery and analysis.

plaw-106-525-2000.creator: United States Congress
plaw-106-525-2000.description: Public Law 106-525 (2000): Minority Health and Health Disparities Research and Education Act of 2000

pmc-10615651.title: Prior SARS-CoV-2 Infection Enhances Initial mRNA Vaccine Response with a Lower Impact on Long-Term Immunity
pmc-10615651.creator: Vanessa Silva-Moraes, Aisha Souquette, Giuseppe A. Sautto, Ida Paciello, Giada Antonelli, Emanuele Andreano, Rino Rappuoli, Andréa Teixeira-Carvalho, Ted M. Ross
pmc-10615651.description: Spike-encoding mRNA vaccines in early 2021 effectively reduced SARS-CoV-2–associated morbidity and mortality. New booster regimens were introduced due to successive waves of distinct viral variants. Therefore, people now have a diverse immune memory resulting from multiple SARS-CoV-2 Ag exposures, from infection to following vaccination.

pmc-11425440.title: S04-4: The HEPA PAT: An in-depth tool to audit HEPA policies at national level
pmc-11425440.creator: Sonja Kahlmeier
pmc-11425440.description: PurposeThe Health-Enhancing Physical Activity Policy Audit Tool (HEPA PAT) a standardized protocol for the detailed compilation and communication of country-level policy responses on physical inactivity. This presentation aims to briefly present the structure of the tool as well as its use in PA policy research.

pmc-11431607.title: Developing an Acceptable Nixtamalised Maize Product for South African Consumers: Sensory, Survey and Nutrient Analysis
pmc-11431607.creator: Taylon Colbert, Carina Bothma, Wilben Pretorius, Alba du Toit, Witoon Prinyawiwatkul, Carolyn F Ross
pmc-11431607.description: South Africa produces high-quality maize, yet food insecurity and malnutrition are prevalent. Maize is a staple for most South Africans and is often eaten as pap, gruel cooked from maize meal (corn flour) and water without diet diversification. Considering the reliance on maize in low-income communities, could nixtamalised maize products be developed that are nutritious, homemade and consumer-acceptable?

pmc-11699580.title: Evaluation of the Anxiolytic and Antidepressant Effects of Standardized Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) Root Extract in Wistar Rats
pmc-11699580.creator: Jayshree Dawane, Sanghee Seok, Priti Dhande, Deepak Langade, Hwana Han, Sang-Back Kim, Jae-Yeong Ju
pmc-11699580.description: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) is a popular herb in Ayurveda, the traditional medicine system in India. It is known to exert stress-mitigating properties and has been extensively studied for its safety and efficacy in various disorders. This in vivo study assessed the effects of Ashwagandha root extract (ARE) on stress in rats.

pmc-12378952.title: Multiscale energetics and submesoscale instabilities of eddy shedding at the Kuroshio loop current in the South China Sea
pmc-12378952.creator: Yunlong Fei, Shaoqing Zhang, Zhengguang Zhang, Yang Gao, Xing Xu, Mengmeng Li, Yangyang Yu, Kaidi Wang, Tong Cui
pmc-12378952.description: The multiscale energetics and submesoscale instabilities after the eddy shedding of Kuroshio Loop Current (KLC) intrusion into the South China Sea (SCS) remain ambiguous. Here, a typical KLC eddy shedding process is well simulated using a downscaled submesoscale-permitting model. Then, energy and dynamics diagnostics are employed to investigate the cross-scale interactions between mesoscales and submesoscales during and after this process.

pmc-12825285.title: A standardized set of pNX vectors for enhanced soluble expression of recombinant proteins in E. coli using small fusion tags
pmc-12825285.creator: Li-Zhen Luo, Wen-Bin Zhang, Zhe Hu, Ling-Hua Zhang, Jin-Cheng Ma, Xue-Bin Jiang
pmc-12825285.description: BackgroundThe production of recombinant proteins in Escherichia coli (E. coli) is often hampered by the formation of inclusion bodies. While fusion tags can enhance solubility, existing systems are hampered by a lack of standardization, with tags scattered across disparate plasmid backbones and inconsistent cloning sites, complicating parallel screening.

pmc-13039014.title: Global feasible path planning for pest monitoring robots in unstructured agricultural environments
pmc-13039014.creator: Yipeng Shao, Fazhan Tao, Pengju Si, Baofeng Ji, Mengyang Li
pmc-13039014.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In the context of sustainable agriculture and precision agriculture, autonomous mobile robots play a pivotal role in intelligent plant pest and disease detection. However, navigation within complex agricultural environments—characterized by narrow crop rows and irregular obstacles—remains a persistent challenge. To address these limitations, this study presents a Goal-Oriented Adaptive Bidirectional RRT* (GABi-RRT*) algorithm designed to overcome the issues of low sampling efficiency and unstable path quality that are inherent in the conventional RRT* algorithm in narrow spaces.

pmc-13519176.title: Early Experience with Force-Modulating Tissue Bridges (FMTB, Brijjit) for Skin Closure in Foot and Ankle Surgery: A Single-Surgeon Case Series
pmc-13519176.creator: Nicholas Stamatos, Eric Giza, Alexandra Ernst, Christopher D Kreulen
pmc-13519176.description: Background:Wound complications following foot and ankle surgery remain challenging, with rates of 4% to 36% depending on procedure complexity. Mechanical tension contributes to dehiscence through mechanotransduction pathways. The force-modulating tissue bridge (FMTB) reduces tissue-interface pressure from approximately 4000 mm Hg (sutures) to 20 mm Hg.

pmc-13546165.title: Low-kVp techniques for radiation dose optimization in abdominopelvic contrast-enhanced CT: a scoping review
pmc-13546165.creator: Nitika C Panakkal, Rajagopal Kadavigere, Suresh Sukumar, N Ravishankar, Shivanath Shanbhag, Visakh Thrivikraman Nair
pmc-13546165.description: Contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CECT) of the abdomen and pelvis is widely used for diagnostic imaging but contributes substantially to cumulative medical radiation exposure. Low tube voltage (kVp) imaging has gained attention as a practical strategy for radiation dose optimization while maintaining diagnostic image quality.

pmc-13663118.title: Chromosome-scale genome of Ormosia hosiei provides insights into legume tree genome evolution
pmc-13663118.creator: Yi Wang, Minhao Liu, Liang Shi, Binhao Yang, Linli Dai, Hanbo Yang, Jinwu Li, Huimin Zhao, Xingcui Xiao, Hongying Guo, Yunjie Gu, Jian Peng
pmc-13663118.description: BackgroundOrmosia hosiei, commonly known as the “Chinese love bean tree” for its traditional symbolic association with love and longing in Chinese literature, is an economically and ecologically important leguminous tree species endemic to China, prized for its high-density hardwood and its vital ecological functions in subtropical forests.

uslaw-usc-t49-s80109.title: 49 U.S.C. § 80109 — Liens under negotiable bills
uslaw-usc-t49-s80109.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s80109.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Chapter 801 (Bills Of Lading). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. A common carrier issuing a negotiable bill of lading has a lien on the goods covered by the bill for— (1) charges for storage, transportation, and delivery (including demurrage and terminal charges), and expenses necessary to preserve the goods or incidental to transporting the goods after.
